findings.description: The original branch target was not actionable because it referenced `ralph/codex-v5-int` as if it were still the required base, even though the maintained `.5` line is already tagged at HEAD.
findings.resolution: Updated the plan to require a dedicated branch from `codex/main` at `release/0.135.0-copilot-api.5` (or directly from that tag if main has moved).
findings.suggestedFix: Name the exact maintained base for the future implementation branch.

findings.description: The draft cited Tenant 1 but did not record seams considered, chosen option, edit-budget estimate, and re-conflict probability for the upstream-canonical marker edits.
findings.resolution: Added an `Upstream-canonical seam decisions` table that records the considered seams, chosen placement, edit budget, and re-conflict probability for the `multi_agents.rs` and `resume_picker.rs` marker edits.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a dedicated seam-decision section for the only upstream-canonical edits.

findings.description: The paste-burst retirement work was too narrow because the stale divergence appears in both the main section 11 entry and the conflict-resolution guide reapply note.
findings.resolution: Expanded the plan to require updating every stale paste-burst reference, explicitly including the main divergence entry and the conflict-resolution-guide note.
findings.suggestedFix: Call out every stale paste-burst occurrence rather than a single section.

findings.description: The draft extended `audit_invariants.sh` but did not make the audit command itself an explicit verification gate.
findings.resolution: Made `bash scripts/audit_invariants.sh` the mandatory verification command and added it to the implementation strategy and acceptance criteria.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the exact audit command the implementer must run.

findings.description: The AC wording was not fully testable because phrases like `appropriately scoped` and `focused verification hook` did not identify the exact marker checks or expected verification behavior.
findings.resolution: Tightened the acceptance criteria to require explicit marker-presence/drift checks in `audit_invariants.sh` and an exit-0 audit run.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace vague criteria with explicit marker and audit expectations.

findings.description: The draft required `.4` families to gain exact source anchors but did not list those anchors for every family.
findings.resolution: Added explicit source anchors for every `.4` and `.5` family directly in the implementation strategy and acceptance criteria.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the intended file/function anchors for each documented family.

findings.description: The draft did not account for stale `disable_paste_burst` guidance in `codex/CLAUDE.md`, leaving a second operator-facing rebase hazard after the registry refresh.
findings.resolution: Added `codex/CLAUDE.md` to the planned edit set and expanded the paste-burst acceptance criteria to cover every stale reference, including the stale CLAUDE guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat the stale CLAUDE guidance as part of the same retirement pass.

findings.description: Verification was incomplete for a shell-guard edit because the draft named `bash scripts/audit_invariants.sh` but not a shell syntax check.
findings.resolution: Updated the plan to require both `bash -n scripts/audit_invariants.sh` and `bash scripts/audit_invariants.sh` as explicit verification commands.
findings.suggestedFix: Add both syntax and functional shell verification commands.

findings.description: The marker-placement requirement was still subjective because it did not identify the exact functions/blocks that should receive the new `SANDBOX PATCH` anchors.
findings.resolution: Specified the concrete anchor blocks for both files: `waiting_begin()` / `waiting_end()` / `agent_label_spans()` in `multi_agents.rs`, and `start_initial_load()` / `schedule_first_page_reconcile()` / `load_more_if_needed()` in `resume_picker.rs`.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the exact functions or blocks where the markers must land.

findings.description: Leaving `codex/.claude/commands/rebase-upstream.md` optional risked keeping stale summary-file guidance after the registry refresh.
findings.resolution: Changed the plan to require a grep-based stale-reference check for `rebase-upstream.md` and to update the file if stale `.130`, paste-burst, or missing-family guidance remains.
findings.suggestedFix: Require an explicit stale-reference check on `rebase-upstream.md`.

findings.description: The draft used `.5` tag names imprecisely across repos, which could confuse whether the wrapper or the inner workspace tag should be used as the implementation base.
findings.resolution: Clarified the repo-specific release pair: wrapper `codex/` tag `v0.135.0-copilot-api.5` and inner `codex-rs` tag `release/0.135.0-copilot-api.5`.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the wrapper and inner tag forms separately.

findings.description: The original draft omitted `tool_lifecycle.rs`, even though it is a live agent-name display seam without a `SANDBOX PATCH:` marker.
findings.resolution: Added `tool_lifecycle.rs` to the planned edit set and made the agent-name family require markers in both `tool_lifecycle.rs` and `multi_agents.rs`.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat the full agent-name family as a coupled marker pass.

findings.description: The draft risked retiring only one paste-burst section while leaving the conflict-resolution-guide instructions and related stale operator guidance intact.
findings.resolution: Expanded the paste-burst retirement scope to cover the main section, duplicate later section, conflict-resolution-guide note, possible stale config-test guidance, and `codex/CLAUDE.md`.
findings.suggestedFix: Make every stale paste-burst instruction part of the same retirement pass.

findings.description: The draft did not clearly distinguish which families already had markers and which specific files still needed new ones, creating risk of redundant source edits.
findings.resolution: Restricted new markers to `tool_lifecycle.rs`, `multi_agents.rs`, and `resume_picker.rs`, and explicitly stated that the other `.4` / `.5` families remain registry-only unless a grep proves they lack markers.
findings.suggestedFix: State exactly which files get new markers and keep the rest registry-only.
